source_text.body:
Hand everyday errands to a local agent
A commenter lists tasks given to a trusted local agent: planning flights and hotels, converting music, finding DRM-free ebooks, designing 3D-printed holders, and tracking email appointments.
·
Oct 6, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The commenter runs a local agent they trust not to share conversations, and uses it like a search engine in place of a browser. They hand it errands: plan flights, a hotel and sights for a conference talk, convert downloaded FLAC music to OGG for a player, find DRM-free epubs for owned books, and make a tweakable OpenSCAD holder from a photo beside a tape measure.
How it went
The comment only lists use cases. It reports no results, numbers, or failures, so there is no evidence here of how well any task worked.
Worth knowing
The setup hinges on a local agent you trust to keep conversations private; the comment doesn't name the model or tools.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Help me with these errands: [list tasks, e.g. plan a trip from [city] to [city] on [dates] with flight and hotel options under [budget], find DRM-free ebook editions of [titles], convert my music files in [folder] to [format]]. For each one, give me a short summary of what you found or did, with links or file locations. Pause and show me the details before booking, buying, or deleting anything.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49980512
